channel.title: Krisala Hiranandani Township Hinjewadi • Official Project Dispatches
channel.description: Official dispatches, construction updates, phase releases, and architectural developments for the 105-Acre Krisala Hiranandani Integrated Equestrian Township in North Hinjewadi, Pune.

item.title: Official Release: 105-Acre Krisala Hiranandani Master Township Unveiled in North Hinjewadi, Pune
item.description: Krisala Developers and Hiranandani Communities announce the formal launch of Pune's first integrated neoclassical equestrian township featuring Sector Arcadia, Sector Icon, and India's first 8-acre private racecourse.

item.title: Everlyn Residences Phase 3: Premium 2 & 3 BHK Floor Plans Released for Sector Arcadia
item.description: Detailed Mivan architectural blueprints and starting price guidance (₹79 Lakhs* onwards) released for Sector Arcadia 2 and 3 BHK homes overlooking landscaped podium gardens.

item.title: The Della Collection: Limited 100 Equestrian Villa Plots with Private Polo Track Membership
item.description: Curated by Della Resorts, 2,000 to 5,000 sq.ft. luxury villa plots open for priority allocation with exclusive privileges at the 8-acre championship equestrian track.

item.title: Interactive Masterplan & Zoning Blueprint: 70% Open Space & TERI 50-Year Hydrology
item.description: Explore the 105-acre zoning masterplan highlighting low-density residential sectors, civic arteries, solar corridors, and eco-resilience reservoirs.

item.title: Investment Whitepaper: Why Hinjewadi Phase 3 Integrated Townships Command 16% YoY Appreciation
item.description: Comprehensive real estate analysis exploring capital growth multipliers driven by the upcoming Hinjewadi-Shivajinagar Metro Line 3 and PMRDA 128m Ring Road.

item.title: Pune Real Estate Research Blog: Hinjewadi & Mahalunge Price Trends, Metro Line 3 Catalysts, and MahaRERA PR1260002502438 Audits
item.description: Authoritative 6-part Pune real estate research dossier covering Hinjewadi vs Mahalunge vs Baner vs Hadapsar market dynamics, 2, 3, 4, 5 BHK pricing benchmarks, and neoclassical architectural appreciation case studies.

item.title: Sector Arcadia Residences: 2 & 3 BHK Monolithic Mivan Homes in 105-Acre Integrated Township
item.description: Sector Arcadia features high-speed Mivan monolithic construction, 780 to 1,180 sq.ft. carpet residences, zero hallway dead-space floor plans, and low-density podium greens.

item.title: Sector Icon Ultra-Luxury Sky Villas & 18-Ft Double-Height Duplexes Unveiled
item.description: Sector Icon introduces limited 3, 4 & 5 BHK duplex sky mansions with private rooftop decks, high-speed elevators, and front-row views of the 8-acre championship racecourse. MahaRERA PR1260002600818.

item.title: 2026 Comprehensive Price List, Payment Milestones, and Bank Approvals Published
item.description: Official pricing matrix starting ₹79 Lakhs*, construction-linked payment (CLP) plans, interactive EMI calculator, and loan pre-approvals from SBI, HDFC, ICICI, and Axis Bank.

item.title: India's 1st Residential 8-Acre Private Racecourse & Polo Club at Krisala Hiranandani
item.description: Exclusive equestrian lifestyle with a 6-furlong turf track, professional horse riding academy, dressage arenas, and private clubhouse viewing lounges curated with Della Resorts.
